statement: The dup-pin weld is a per-dropped-loop decision behind three tests: fully pinnable, battery-supported (record normal absent or dup-pinned coordinates coplanar at PLANE_TOL=2e-3), and mesh-safe (no degenerate emission; the incremental undirected edge-use guard keeps every edge at <=2 uses). The empty-primary-mesh precondition and both per-rep store-level gates are removed.

label: fact

statement: The mesh guard is incremental: the edge histogram is built once from the call's primary triangles, then each accepted loop's edge uses fold in; a candidate loop is histogrammed locally (O its triangles) and refused if any edge would exceed 2 uses or a degenerate triangle appears. Fail-closed; loop order is record/encounter order.
label: fact
